title: Page 244
transc:
SH Beckwith  Washn Decr 8th 1864
Jennie Fisher Bellows The costume authorizes such transfer
of violet quadrants shoe may deem proper The
transfers should be watsoned to Bargain talbot peru
toby noted on rolls yard There are still
over Arnold Dwight Enlisted village samples at Rock
Island who have received bounties butter ufkno use
HW Halleck
Chf Staff 


No 1.  9 PM
<deletion>Smith</deletion> <insertion>Clowry</insertion> St Louis Mo  Washn. D. C. Dec 8. 1864 
Rosalie platina for Dodge ---- Send all the
whiff you can spare to lantern by such
route as you may deem best ---- They
can be returned to you when required ---- I
think plaster Woodbury spit can be spared from Aragon
Bennet


no 2  9 PM
Beckwith City Pt.  Washn. D. C. Dec 8 1864
Rosetta crowd few wish nuisance relieved 
from prospect give the repeat pike
No Brown here will I think
interfere ---- The responsibility however will be
yours as no brown here so far
as I am informed wishes niggard removed comet
